items.html: *Indeed, the first light, which was at first below and rose upward, did not descend again, and remained there from the Tabur upward, and there it placed its root permanently. And from there it expanded and came out through the Einayim; and these are the Nekudim, and it was extended and expanded on the outside, down to the end of the feet of AK. Now, all the light that is extended down to the Tabur, even though it is of the discernment of the Einayim, is all swallowed up and included in the Akudim, and therefore it is not recognisable. But the light that is extended from below the Tabur down to his feet, this alone is called by the name Nekudot, since it now stands alone.
